meeting_point: Caffe Umbria, 959 West Ave Suite 1, Miami Beach, FL 33139
description: Discover the best of Miami Beach on a fun and relaxing bike tour, perfect for all fitness levels! Pedal through the iconic Art Deco district, soak in the sun along Ocean Drive, visit the amazing homes of Star Island, and explore the unique culture and top attractions of this tropical paradise. This is the ultimate way to experience Miami Beach!
what_to_bring:
Bring a refillable water bottle
Wear loose, comfortable clothing
